reviews.title: Decent Picture, Simple Setup, Great Everyday Webcam
reviews.comment: The Brio 100 was easy to set up and worked right away with my computer, which I appreciate. It’s compatible with my windows 11 laptop and instantly connected within seconds of plugging it into my docking station. The picture quality is clear and bright, and it does a good job adjusting to different lighting without looking washed out. The built-in mic picks up voices well for regular video calls, and the privacy shutter is a nice touch for when you’re not using it. The clip feels sturdy and stays in place on a monitor or laptop, and the lightweight design makes it easy to reposition. Overall, it’s a solid webcam for everyday meetings, classes, or calls, simple, reliable, and well made.
reviews.author: F.I.T.
